title: BC 2026 KNN index labeled+pseudo
subtitle: L2-normalized Perch v2 embeddings of 13k labeled+pseudo windows
description: KNN index for inference-time retrieval. 13,022 L2-normalized Perch v2 embeddings (1536-d) from BirdCLEF 2026 labeled train_soundscapes + v4 pseudo-labels, with per-row 234-d label vectors. Use cosine similarity + multi-K voting (K=10/20/50). Adds +0.020 macro-AUC over Bruce-only baseline.
